title: Hoboken rent control ordinance — rent increase limits
requirement: Rents are controlled at the base rent level received as of October 1, 1985; no rent increase may be charged unless allowed by this chapter, and a landlord seeking an increase must give the tenant written notice at least 30 days before it takes effect.
coverage_conditions: All dwelling units, except motels/hotels, newly constructed dwellings at first rental, industrial and nonresidential/commercial property, school/college student housing, government-owned housing, buildings vacant since January 1, 1984, and multiple dwellings built after June 25, 1987 under N.J.S.A. 2A:42-84.1.

applicability.per_tenancy: Newly constructed dwellings and buildings vacant since January 1, 1984 are exempt only for the initial rent or lease; commercial units in mixed-use buildings are exempt while residential units remain covered.
coverage_quotes: This chapter shall apply to all dwelling units as defined in § 155-1 above, except that the following shall be exempt:
Housing owned and operated by other government agencies, such as the state or federal government.

the provisions of this chapter shall not apply to multiple dwellings, as defined in the statute, constructed after June 25, 1987, for a period not to exceed the period of amortization of any initial mortgage loan obtained for the multiple dwelling or for 30 years following completion of construction, whichever is less.

exemptions: Motels and hotels; newly constructed dwellings at first rental; industrial property; nonresidential and commercial units; school/college student housing; government-owned housing; buildings vacant since January 1, 1984; multiple dwellings constructed after June 25, 1987 (N.J.S.A. 2A:42-84.1).
penalty: Rent increases above those allowed are null and void; excess rents must be refunded or credited to the tenant.
quoted_span: All rents for rental of housing space and services in dwellings to which this act is applicable are hereby controlled at the base rent level received by the landlord as of October 1, 1985, and no rental increases shall be hereinafter demanded, paid or accepted, except as provided in this chapter.
interaction: Chapter application is preempted while a governmental agency contract regulates the rents, and resumes after the contract terminates.
